evidence.title: Gradient Studio — Free Procedural CSS Gradient Generator | Amit Gajare

name: Gradient Studio
summary: Free procedural CSS gradient generator for editorial backgrounds, exporting CSS, Tailwind or SCSS.
description: A single-page generator that produces full-spectrum, duotone and monochrome colour ramps with layered light treatments (mesh glow, aurora waves, film grain, bokeh, caustics and 46+ effects), 19 curated colour families and 0-360 degree angle control. Copy the result as CSS, Tailwind or SCSS with no account; free for personal and commercial use.
contains: palette modes: full, duotone, monochrome, triad, split, pastel, dark
keyboard shortcuts, palette lock and history
free, no account, commercial use allowed
